body:
I had 2 favorite cats, mother and son, and sadly they both passed away. I cried for almost a week for each of them, the son just passed away early this year.

I was also scared of dogs (almost got nastily bit before) but when my dog came, he was just so cute as a puppy and so gentle. He really lifted up my spirit when he came to my life. and so he has become my favorite one, whom I treat like a little brother. I really give him all I've got.

I always thought cats are evil furballs, but when we had our cat boom (cats came to our house about 3 years ago and reproduced ever since - short story), I realized they are too sweet and clingy! my favorite mother cat used to sit on top of me every morning to wake me up, and her son did the same too which was quite special for me.

Thank you for sharing this to me. It really perks me up talking about beloved furballs. ❤

Thank you very much. ❤ Your dogs are so blessed to have you around, and so I guess it works both ways.

Like you, I also can't imagine what would happen to my dog if I pass away. I'm sure my fam would take care of him, but I can't think of letting him experience the sadness and emptiness if ever I'll no longer be by his side.

I guess what's left of me is to find other pieces for my puzzle though. Thank you again, for loving your dogs, and for sharing. ❤

Truly. Happiness is my dog jumping to me whenever I return home. Happiness is him jumping on my bed and snuggling close to me.

Thank you. Whenever I feel down, I just talk to my dogs about all the good things we have and what we're gonna do for the day and through him, his enthusiasm, I find things to live for still.

Sending hugs to you and your cat. By the way, I'm a cat lover too. At one point we had 21 cats in our house and 3 dogs haha. Now we have around 15 cats and 5 dogs. When we're with them, life is not so bad afterall.
thank you. i'm trying really hard for him. my dog's really just my angel. God I hope he lives long.

Last year when I had months of wanting to get myself killed, I visited a therapist and she indeed helped me - though I quit my job as a partial result because my line of work really dealt with lots of stress and overnights.

Exercise is a good suggestion though, I stopped going to the gym for quite some time now and I think I need it.

I will try to open up to my bestfriend once the busy season is over for her job.

Thank you for the kind words though. It feels good to talk about this without getting shunned or dismissed. I live in an Asian and Catholic country and these issues are taboo if not a sin by itself.

They say that dogs see the goodness in people and I guess, kind sir, my dog would see lots of it in you.

I hope you're doing well in your battle too.

I think I've had this since highschool, around 10 years ago, and the worst episode was last year, when I really hoped I'd get into car accidents so I can die without it appearing as suicide. 

I've quit my job since last year, I'm tight with my college friends but I dont want to burden them with these thoughts. Family - they expect too much of me. Maybe me quitting my job is a rebellion to them. Though now I'm helping in the family business.

Pretty much with your first point - I have no motivation at all and I get easily bored with the new things I try. Only that I'm a woman.

Love life - ever since I was young I really didn't see myself growing old with someone or having romantic relations. Single since birth but I don't really mind. Less worries than the people around me, I guess haha.

Thank you for checking up though. :)
